baseline.timing_note: Final refit duration was not persisted before the export error; fold timings are available.

optimization.selection_rule: highest mean temporal AP; baseline retained if gain <= 1e-6

interpretability.method: native XGBoost TreeSHAP (tree-path-dependent; no background dataset)
limitations: Sample uniform; few positive examples make permutation AP variable.
Correlated original/derived features complicate permutation and PDP/ICE; perturbations may be unrealistic.
SHAP contributions add in raw log-odds, not probability; scores are not calibrated.
No protected demographic attributes: no demographic fairness claim. Explanations are not causal.

monitoring.deployment: historical local replay; no live deployment

controlled_scenario.description: Synthetic ONLY: flip 15% of labels after midpoint, seed42; original data/model unchanged.

adwin.interpretation: Observed changes in error mean are investigation signals, not proof of conditional concept drift. No alert is not proof of stationarity.
